result.title: CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation
result.summary: Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.

AI.brief_summary: 研究互补标签学习（CLL）中来自众包或 VLM 的标注错误（真实类别被误标为互补标签），指出直接迁移最优传输（OT）数据估值会因语义错配而失效，并提出 CAVA：引入互补标签代价与标签 margin，无参数阈值检测对角噪声，并把检出的样本回收为普通标签监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用 OT 数据估值识别有害监督样本」的思路可供核查，可能迁移到 latent 轨迹训练中的监督信号筛选与贡献分配；但论文本身面向分类标注噪声，与 VLM 推理状态生成、视觉证据使用无直接联系。
